content: {"like": ["The material on the DVDs is valuable and could be presented in a much better way for public school students.", "It could work for parents of literate, inquisitive children to show at home.", "Certain segments, such as the garderobe, are of high interest."], "dislike": ["The DVD is slow and interesting only in small portions.", "It is hard to hear and lacks subtitles.", "Production values are poor and the animation is primitive, resembling South Park more than Warner Brothers.", "The formula of Mr. Macaulay ambling around exchanging pearls of wisdom with a female counterpart is largely a non-starter for contemporary adolescents.", "The female sidekick’s French accent is difficult for students to understand.", "The exaggerated cartoonish animation undermines the overall quality of the DVD."]}
